response_excerpt.summary: The analysis joined traffic and orders tables by product_id and date, then aggregated by traffic channel. Across all four channels (ads, social, referral, organic), traffic volumes are very similar (~700K page views and ~413K–421K unique visitors each). Paid order counts are also close: ads (1,000) and referral (1,000) slightly outperform social (955) and organic (955). Total paid revenue is highest for ads (~$969,919) and lowest for organic (~$632,520). Conversion rates (paid orders / unique visitors) are nearly identical across all channels at 0.23%–0.24%, indicating consistent purchasing behavior regardless of traffic source.

request_excerpt.query: Using SQL only, join the traffic and orders tables by product_id and date, then summarize by traffic channel. Return channel, total page views, total unique visitors, paid order count, paid revenue, and a concise conversion-rate summary.
